entry_caps.rule: re-entry not allowed: one entry per symbol per session

change_note: primary pre-registered configuration N5 k1.5 p30 edge

cost_model.pnl_basis: modelled: each trade is sized independently to capital x risk per trade / stop fraction, capped at capital x leverage, with no limit on concurrent positions or total capital; net is after the modelled statutory charges and slippage

rows.title: Net expectancy at 1.0x cost
rows.threshold: >= +0.05R per trade
rows.evidence: net expectancy -0.031R over 1657 trades (statutory-per-trade, broker flattrade, mean 11.55 bps)

rows.title: Gross edge vs cost
rows.threshold: gross / cost >= 1.5 is comfortable
rows.evidence: gross 8.57 bps against 11.548 bps round trip: thin (primary mean, statutory-per-trade, broker flattrade, mean 11.55 bps); legacy flat 16 bps would give 0.54, secondary

rows.title: Edge over matched random entry
rows.threshold: report: paired excess net bps over the matched random-entry baseline
rows.evidence: strategy net -2.9813 bps against random entry -12.2669 bps over 1657 matched trades: excess 9.3 bps, t 3.5; the signal adds value beyond random entry

rows.title: Latency
rows.threshold: report: entry delayed by one 5-minute bar; flag if the sign flips (alert lag is seconds, so one bar is a severe case)
rows.evidence: no latency stage was run for this run (opt-in)

rows.title: Bar resolution
rows.threshold: report: stop-first against the pessimistic same-bar reading of exits; flag if the sign flips
rows.evidence: The intraday engine takes the stop before the target when one bar spans both, and fills a bar that opens beyond the stop at the open (STOP FIRST, pinned by engine tests). That is the pessimistic same-bar reading, so for this run the two readings are the same rule, the result is identical and the sign cannot flip. By construction, not by a second run. It covers the original stop and target only; a plan that raises the stop from the next bar is outside it and is not evaluated

rows.title: Dispersion
rows.threshold: top 10 symbols <= 40% of net profit, >= 50% of symbols net positive
rows.evidence: net profit -51.6R is not positive; 44% of 200 symbols net positive

rows.title: Direction
rows.threshold: longs and shorts reported separately; a one-sided strategy is declared
rows.evidence: 770 long / 887 short trades; net -0.066R long, -0.001R short

rows.title: Survivorship
rows.threshold: report: the universe uses today's list, which is survivor-biased; test on symbols as they existed and list names that later left
rows.evidence: membership source current_symbol_master; survivorship bias True. The universe is today's symbol master applied to the past, not point-in-time membership: names that later left F&O or were delisted are absent and cannot be listed here because no historical membership source exists. Results are biased toward survivors

rows.title: Event days
rows.evidence: needs an event calendar

rows.title: Monte Carlo
rows.threshold: at least 5,000 bootstrap paths, day-block and trade-level, at the deployed risk per trade: 95th percentile max drawdown at most 25% of capital and probability of ruin below 5%
rows.evidence: no Monte Carlo stage was run for this run (opt-in)

rows.title: Live caps applied
rows.threshold: the live caps applied while the strategy runs; capped net expectancy >= +0.05R per trade and >= 200 trades (the G1.2 and G2.1 bars)
rows.evidence: no run with the live caps was recorded; only a generic first-come-first-served slot sweep of the recorded trades exists (3 slots: net -2.95 bps; 5 slots: net -3.21 bps; 10 slots: net -2.98 bps), which applies no live limit. Information only, not evidence for this gate

rows.title: Sizing
rows.threshold: risk per trade at most 1% of capital and never above 50% of the estimated Kelly fraction
rows.evidence: risk per trade 1.00% of capital against the 1% cap; estimated Kelly 0.00% per trade and 0.00% per session, the smaller (0.00%) used; 50% of it is 0.00%: the book has no positive edge to size (over). Kelly is a point estimate from 1657 recorded trades over 1113 sessions (log-optimal on net R, grouped by IST entry date, uncapped trade list), so it is only as reliable as that sample. This is not proof that live sizing is safe: the risk is the nominal fraction the cost model sizes on, not a re-derivation of live sizing, and no portfolio cap, margin or capacity is applied

rows.title: Capacity
rows.threshold: every entry order at most 10% of the median 5-minute volume at its entry time
rows.evidence: no capacity stage was run for this run (opt-in)

rows.title: Margin
rows.threshold: worst-case simultaneous MIS margin at most 90% of capital
rows.evidence: the margin comes from the capped replay and no run with the live caps was recorded (opt-in --live-caps)

rows.title: Chronological hold-out
rows.threshold: last 30% to 40% of sessions
rows.evidence: 32.1% of trade days held out from 2023-11-08; whether it stayed untouched until the candidate was frozen is not recorded

rows.title: Out-of-sample result
rows.threshold: OOS net > 0 and >= 40% of in-sample
rows.evidence: OOS -0.036R (560 trades) vs in-sample -0.029R (1097 trades)

rows.title: Walk-forward
rows.threshold: at least 4 rolling windows of 6 months; net above 0 in at least 60%
rows.evidence: 9 of 19 windows net positive (0 empty); shipped parameters held fixed in every window, so this is rolling stability, not a re-fit per window

rows.title: Symbol hold-out
rows.threshold: both symbol halves net > 0, weaker >= 40% of stronger
rows.evidence: half A -0.039R (793 trades), half B -0.024R (864 trades)

rows.title: Leakage and embargo
rows.threshold: no trade straddles the split; embargo of at least 1 session
rows.evidence: 0 trades straddled the cut and were purged from in-sample; embargo 1 session(s) removed 0 out-of-sample trades

rows.title: Cost model
rows.threshold: statutory charges at deployed notional plus slippage
rows.evidence: statutory schedule (MIS, NSE) priced per trade at the deployed notional (capital 100,000, risk 1.00% per trade, leverage 5x) plus 4 bps slippage per side: mean 11.55 bps against the legacy flat 16 bps

rows.title: Slippage stress
rows.threshold: net expectancy above 0 with slippage doubled (8 bps per side)
rows.evidence: net -0.123R at 2.0x slippage (1.0x -0.031R); total cost 11.55 bps at 1.0x, 15.55 bps at 1.5x, 19.55 bps at 2.0x; other scenarios, report only: generic_discount_broker net -7.56 bps, legacy_flat net -7.43 bps

rows.title: Cost per trade in R
rows.threshold: median cost <= 0.40R
rows.evidence: median cost 0.126R per trade (statutory-per-trade, broker flattrade, mean 11.55 bps)

rows.title: Stop floor
rows.threshold: report: if a fixed floor sets most stops (more than 50% at one width), show results at other floors

rows.title: Sub-periods
rows.threshold: >= 60% of calendar years net positive, worst year >= -0.25R
rows.evidence: 4 of 10 years net positive; worst 2021 at -0.110R; market regimes are scored by X.2

rows.title: Regime dispersion
rows.threshold: heuristic (calibrated): net positive in every sampled regime of each judged dimension
rows.evidence: no regime block supplied for this run

rows.title: Regime activation hypothesis
rows.threshold: hypothesis only; validate the filtered strategy out-of-sample
rows.evidence: no regime block supplied for this run

rows.title: Parameter perturbation
rows.threshold: at least 7 in 10 of the +-20% one-at-a-time neighbours net positive, and none keeping less than 40% of the base net R per trade
rows.evidence: the perturbation stage was not run for this run

rows.title: Trade count
rows.threshold: >= 200 net trades
rows.evidence: 1657 trades

rows.title: Day-clustered t-statistic
rows.threshold: >= 2.64 at 6 trials
rows.evidence: day-clustered t -0.99, against the larger of the criteria level 2.50 and the record's Sidak hurdle 2.64 (1112 degrees of freedom)

rows.title: Deflated Sharpe
rows.threshold: DSR >= 0.90 at the true trial count
rows.evidence: DSR 0.008 over 2404 sessions at 6 trials (daily Sharpe -0.024 against a deflation threshold of 0.026); series: each trade booked on its entry session, idle sessions zero-filled (calendar sessions); assumption: trial Sharpe variance is assumed to be the no-edge sampling variance, because only the trial count is recorded

rows.title: Probability of backtest overfitting
rows.threshold: PBO (CSCV) at most 0.30 across the variants tried
rows.evidence: 6 trials were tried; PBO needs the daily P&L of each variant on a common grid and is not computed yet (stats.pbo_cscv exists)

rows.title: Trials ledger
rows.threshold: every variant tried is counted in trials.yaml; DSR and the t-hurdle use that count
rows.evidence: n_trials 6 from trials.yaml: 1 material and 5 external

rows.title: Dependence (Newey-West)
rows.threshold: t on daily aggregated P&L with a Newey-West autocorrelation adjustment
rows.evidence: Newey-West t -1.21 over 2404 sessions (plain daily t -1.18; series: each trade booked on its entry session, idle sessions zero-filled (calendar sessions)); compare with the G2.2 bar, which the trade-clustered t already has to clear

rows.title: Track length
rows.threshold: sample length against the Minimum Track Record Length at 95 percent
rows.evidence: 2404 sessions observed; the observed Sharpe is not above zero, so no track length would be enough (series: each trade booked on its entry session, idle sessions zero-filled (calendar sessions))

rows.title: Corporate actions
rows.threshold: report: split and bonus sessions excluded or adjusted; ex-date handling verified
rows.evidence: policy: intraday: sessions whose open versus previous close ratio lies outside 0.75 to 1.33 are excluded as probable splits; daily: back-adjusted for detected splits; dividends, bonuses and rights issues are NOT detected. This run excluded 0 symbol-sessions across 0 symbols as probable splits. Limits: the 0.75 to 1.33 test cannot see dividends, bonuses or rights, and ex-date handling is not verified, so this gate does not pass

rows.title: Daily eligibility
rows.threshold: report: skip names under ASM, GSM or T2T, names the broker blocks for MIS, and names without a valid tick; log each by name
rows.evidence: data-driven eligibility policy (min_prior_sessions=60, min_volume=1.0, min_price=10.0 on NSE raw last-bar close (factors from nse-daily-20261019-001)); 6654 symbol-sessions NOT_ELIGIBLE (LISTING_AGE=4320, PRICE_FLOOR=2334), each logged by symbol and date in exclusions.parquet. ASM, GSM, T2T and broker MIS block lists are not modelled

rows.title: Circuits
rows.threshold: report: entries whose stop or target lies beyond the day's price band; bounds 2% (tightest fixed band) and 10% (F&O dynamic range)
rows.evidence: 809 of 1657 entries (48.8%) have a stop or target beyond 2% of the signal price and 2 (0.1%) beyond 10%; the furthest level is 11.71%. This is a bound, not a check against the actual daily bands (not held), and the signal price stands in for the previous close

rows.title: Tick size

rows.evidence: all 1657 stop triggers are on the exchange tick grid of their own date (dated reference v1, partial verification, sha256 a0714114834f). Broker acceptance of a trigger is a pre-live check, not part of this gate.

rows.evidence: 4 of 1657 trades (0.2%) exited by SL_GAP or SL_GAP_ENTRY; mean loss beyond the stop 0.005R. The live stop type (SL-M versus SL) is not tested here
